title: State-sponsored group drove coding agents for largely autonomous espionage
actor: State-sponsored group (vendor-assessed), humans at decision points only
summary: A state-sponsored group drove coding-agent instances through reconnaissance, intrusion, escalation, and collection against ~30 targets, with the agent performing most operational work and humans intervening only at decision points. Detection came from the model vendor's abuse monitoring rather than any victim — a warning about where visibility currently sits.

chain.BREACH: Conventional intrusion executed by the agent.
chain.CHANNEL: Operator direction at decision points only.
chain.HALT: Vendor abuse-monitoring detection; accounts disabled; findings published.
